home.title: Shani Mandal Temple
home.subtitle: A Sacred Sanctuary in Nandurbar
home.description: Located in the heart of Nandurbar, Maharashtra, Shani Mandal Temple is a revered place of worship dedicated to Lord Shanidev. Our temple welcomes devotees from all walks of life to seek blessings, find peace, and connect with the divine.
home.aboutText: Shani Mandal Temple has been a beacon of spiritual light for our community. We invite you to experience the divine presence and participate in our daily prayers and special ceremonies.

history.title: Temple History
history.subtitle: A Sacred Legacy of Devotion and Faith
history.originText: The worship of celestial deities holds a special place in Hindu tradition. Among them, Lord Shani is known as the divine force of justice. The Shani Mandal Temple of Nandurbar stands as one of the sacred places where devotees believe their 'Sade Sati' ends with the darshan of Lord Shani.
history.legendText: According to legend, King Vikramaditya once mocked Lord Shani in his royal court. Angered, Shani Dev descended and declared that he would test the king. During this period, Vikramaditya suffered greatly but learned humility and faith. In the end, Lord Shani restored his honor and chose to reside here — blessing the village with divine protection. Thus, the place came to be known as 'Shani Mandal'.
history.architectureText: The temple, estimated to be 700–800 years old, features a blend of traditional Marathi and South Indian architecture. Inside, the sanctum houses a magnificent black stone idol of Lord Shani surrounded by his family and attendants. The ceilings are decorated with colored glass, and the mandap glows with intricate artwork.
history.festivalsText: Major festivals include Shani Jayanti on Vaishakh Amavasya and the grand Shani Amavasya fair, which attracts thousands of devotees from Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Madhya Pradesh. The temple is known as 'Sade Sati Mukti Dham Shakti Peeth' — a place believed to free devotees from planetary afflictions.
history.visitorInfoText: Located about 20 km from Nandurbar, the temple is easily accessible by ST buses and private vehicles. Lodging and food facilities are available nearby for devotees visiting from across states.
history.panditNote: Our respected Pandit Ji has been guiding devotees with deep faith and devotion, preserving the spiritual essence of the temple.
